'''Pandorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] plans on renovating the ruins of [[Dynamet General Hospital]], he asked an Imperial spacer to contaminate the [[Kolto/Legends|Kolto]] [[Kolto tank|tanks]] with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul virus]] before the equipment was restored.<ref name="TOR" />
